# Hypothesis: Analyze QK and OV matrices for each head to understand their eigenvalue spectra,
# symmetry, norms, and relationship to positional vs content addressing.
import numpy as np

HEADS = 6
LAYERS = 4
d = 384
hd = d // HEADS # 64

for l in range(LAYERS):
    W_q = W[f'W_q.{l}']
    W_k = W[f'W_k.{l}']
    W_v = W[f'W_v.{l}']
    W_o = W[f'W_o.{l}']
    
    for h in range(HEADS):
        s = slice(h * hd, (h + 1) * hd)
        # W_q[s, :] is (hd, d), W_k[s, :] is (hd, d)
        # QK matrix in residual space: W_QK = W_q[s].T @ W_k[s] (d, d)
        # Or OV matrix: W_OV = W_o[:, s] @ W_v[s, :] (d, d)
        W_qh = W_q[s, :]
        W_kh = W_k[s, :]
        W_vh = W_v[s, :]
        W_oh = W_o[:, s]
        
        W_qk = W_qh.T @ W_kh # (d, d)
        W_ov = W_oh @ W_vh   # (d, d)
        
        # SVD of W_qh, W_kh, W_vh, W_oh
        sq = np.linalg.svd(W_qh, compute_uv=False)
        sk = np.linalg.svd(W_kh, compute_uv=False)
        sv = np.linalg.svd(W_vh, compute_uv=False)
        so = np.linalg.svd(W_oh, compute_uv=False)
        
        # Eigenvalues of W_ov
        eig_ov = np.linalg.eigvals(W_ov)
        # Sort by magnitude
        eig_ov_sorted = eig_ov[np.argsort(-np.abs(eig_ov))]
        
        # Real positive eigenvalues in W_ov indicate copying behavior (positive trace / positive eigenvalues)
        pos_real_ov = np.sum(eig_ov.real[eig_ov.real > 0])
        neg_real_ov = np.sum(eig_ov.real[eig_ov.real < 0])
        
        # QK trace and symmetry
        # If QK has negative trace: x_i^T W_qk x_i is negative -> avoids attending to self!
        tr_qk = np.trace(W_qk)
        tr_ov = np.trace(W_ov)
        
        print(f"L{l}H{h}: ||W_qk||_F={np.linalg.norm(W_qk):.2f}, tr(QK)={tr_qk:.2f}, "
              f"||W_ov||_F={np.linalg.norm(W_ov):.2f}, tr(OV)={tr_ov:.2f}, "
              f"top_ov_eigs={eig_ov_sorted[:3].round(2)}")
